all_candidates.topic: Will tougher exam leak penalties deter cheating?
all_candidates.news_anchor: India's Lower House approved a Bill on July 29, 2026, to toughen penalties for exam paper leaks.

all_candidates.topic: Should education ministers resign over exam leaks?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan resigned on July 25, 2026, over exam paper leaks.

all_candidates.topic: Should quick-commerce platforms face harsher penalties for delays?
all_candidates.news_anchor: A West Bengal district consumer commission on July 30, 2026, held an e-commerce platform liable for delivery delays.

all_candidates.topic: Is the July 31 ITR filing deadline reasonable?
all_candidates.news_anchor: News on July 29, 2026, highlighted that the Income Tax Return (ITR) filing deadline for eligible taxpayers is July 31, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Should authorities close metro stations during protests?
all_candidates.news_anchor: On July 23, 2026, the Chief Justice of India indicated the Supreme Court may intervene if Delhi metro station closures during protests persist.

all_candidates.topic: Should all AI-generated content require visible labels?
all_candidates.news_anchor: In July 2026, the Indian government issued rules requiring visible labelling of synthetically generated information.

all_candidates.topic: Is government assurance on E20 fuel safety sufficient?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The government stated on July 30, 2026, that E20 petrol does not damage engines and promotes fuel price stability.

all_candidates.topic: Should E0/E10 petrol options be reintroduced?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Centre ruled out restoring petrol with lower ethanol content (E0/E10) on July 23, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Will August 1st credit card changes harm consumers?
all_candidates.news_anchor: News on July 29, 2026, announced 'changes to credit card rewards and fees' taking effect from August 1, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Is the IT sector truly immune to widespread AI layoffs?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The government told Parliament on July 29, 2026, that India's IT sector added 1.35 lakh jobs in FY26, countering AI layoff fears.

all_candidates.topic: Are new Tatkal booking rules truly fair?
all_candidates.news_anchor: News on July 29, 2026, announced 'updated Indian Railways Tatkal booking rules' taking effect from August 1, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Should India create dedicated AI legislation now?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The government of India signaled on July 29, 2026, its intent to pursue dedicated AI legislation.

all_candidates.topic: Will CKYC 2.0 simplify financial onboarding?
all_candidates.news_anchor: News on July 29, 2026, announced the 'rollout of CKYC 2.0' taking effect from August 1, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Is the minor child dual passport restriction fair?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Ministry of Home Affairs notified changes on July 30, 2026, stating a minor child cannot hold two passports.

all_candidates.topic: Are the new OCI card rules beneficial?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The government notified revised Citizenship (Amendment) Rules, 2026, related to OCI cardholders on July 30, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Will the PARIVARTAN scheme effectively curb air pollution?
all_candidates.news_anchor: News on July 30, 2026, discussed the PARIVARTAN Scheme, approved June 3, 2026, for modernizing trucks and buses in Delhi-NCR.

all_candidates.topic: Should all states adopt Uttarakhand's clean mobility push?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Uttarakhand CM flagged off 11 clean-fuel vehicles on July 28, 2026, under a new Clean Mobility Transformation Policy.

all_candidates.topic: Is automatic AATO updation on GST portal helpful?
all_candidates.news_anchor: On July 25, 2026, GSTN advised about upgrading Aggregate Annual Turnover (AATO) functionality with automatic updation from July 1, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Is pausing e-Way Bill enhancements beneficial for businesses?
all_candidates.news_anchor: GSTN announced on July 30, 2026, that proposed e-Way Bill system enhancements scheduled for August 1, 2026, are on hold.

all_candidates.topic: Should private space operators bear full re-entry liability?
all_candidates.news_anchor: India issued new liability norms for planned re-entry of space objects on July 23, 2026, made public July 29-30, 2026.
